derivation:
rw [← Finset.prod_sdiff hs, mul_comm]
  exact PowerSeries.coeff_mul_prod_one_sub_of_lt_order m _ _ _ (by
    intro n hn
    simp only [Finset.mem_sdiff, Finset.mem_range, not_lt] at hn
    simpa [PowerSeries.order_X_pow] using (show m < n + 1 by omega))
explanation: The Mathlib lemma says multiplying a series by a finite product of factors (1 − f i) leaves its mth coefficient unchanged when every f i has order greater than m. For indices in s \ range (m + 1), the factors X^(n + 1) satisfy that order bound. The target’s current proof instead establishes the result using its local Cong lemmas.
